title: Bounded experimental51 adapter and unattached module checks
goal: Replace removed color calls behind an explicit experimental51 switch without publishing partial color configurations or deploying an untested desktop module.

criteria.text: The actual extracted51 adapter and constructor pass deterministic resource, direction, upload-boundary, ownership, cache, HDR-formula and failed-replacement tests without changing the old published configuration.

The experimental native module compiles and links against51 with new public SDK-typed checks, no obsolete color imports and preserved layout stops; its generated51GIR/typelib and private unattached registration/constructor/shutdown checks pass.

Successful selected new stages have authenticated inputs/artifacts, clean recorded diagnostics and known supervised cleanup; failed attempts remain factual failures, allocations stay within the recorded finite scope/replan, and no old test or desktop is activated.

out_of_scope: Actual color-function calling ABI, shader compilation, color/pixel/resource-allocation behavior in the installed library
Mutter/Shell frame integration, HDR/physical output, complete application or deployment acceptance
Default51support, extension activation, host install/package/Nix/release, old closed test replay or performance claims
decisions: This is an opt-in experimental module; metadata and default target remain50 until separate real application validation.
Both directions publish together; new transform ownership lasts through required-resource inspection, and borrowed lists are never freed here.
Only fresh current-application tests are invoked; receipts are verified without replay after their allocations are consumed.
